## 01 QuantumScape Shares Rise as Q1 Update Highlights Eagle Line Startup
QuantumScape's Q1 update has sent the company's shares rising, driven by progress in Eagle Line production and customer momentum. The update highlights the startup of the Eagle Line, which is expected to play a crucial role in the company's plans to commercialize its solid-state battery technology. With a narrower loss than expected, QuantumScape is poised to take on the challenges of the solid-state battery market. As [Quiver Quantitative](https://news.google.) reports, the company's shares have risen in response to the update, indicating growing confidence in QuantumScape's ability to deliver on its solid-state battery promises.

## 02 Solid-State Battery Firms in China and US Prepare for IPO
Solid-state battery companies in China and the US are gearing up for initial public offerings, driven by growing interest in the technology. As [South China Morning Post](https://news.google.) reports, the companies are looking to capitalize on the growing demand for solid-state batteries, which offer improved safety, energy density, and charging speeds compared to traditional lithium-ion batteries.

## 03 Vacuum Maker Dreame Unveils Supercar with 450 Wh/kg Solid-State Battery
Dreame, a vacuum maker, has unveiled a supercar featuring a 450 Wh/kg solid-state battery. The supercar, which can accelerate from 0-100 km/h in just 0.9 seconds, showcases the potential of solid-state technology in high-performance vehicles. As [CarNewsChina.com](https://news.google.?oc=5) reports, the supercar's solid-state battery offers a significant improvement in energy density and charging speeds, making it an attractive option for high-performance vehicles.
